text:
leah_cs: Hey team — customer reports they clicked redeem and saw the success screen for promo code SPRINGLAUNCH23, email confirmation received, but org balance still shows 0. Org id: org_8421, user: emma+trial@example.com. Ticket #8791. Redeem came in ~10:15 UTC. Can someone quick-check ledger/ingest?

mike_billing: Got it. Do we have the webhook/request id from their session or any receipt? Need to see if ledger write happened or was skipped.

leah_cs: Customer forwarded an email with a claim id: claim_5a9f. No backend receipt in the UI. They said they redeemed via the public portal.

jo_eng: Looking at inbound partner callback logs for claim_5a9f — our webhook endpoint returned 200 for the partner, but the ingestion worker logged a tenant-mapping miss and skipped the write. Snippet:```json
{"claim_id":"claim_5a9f","org_external":"acme-marketing","tenant_hint":"merchant_402","status":"accepted"}```

promo-bot: webhook_handler: received callback claim_5a9f -> 200 OK (partner) at 1717777730

mike_billing: Tenant-mapping miss? Is merchant_402 not linked to org_8421? That would explain skipped ledger entries. Can we see the mapping table?

jo_eng: Correct — merchant_402 is linked to a billing account (acct_994) that is attached to a different org (org_9902, internal partner test). The ingestion flow checks merchant->billing_account->org and if inconsistent it rejects to avoid mis-crediting. This one failed that check so write was intentionally skipped.

sasha: Thanks for digging in. Customer is on a trial and needs credits quickly. Options: 1) manual ledger credit to org_8421 with audit note, 2) update mapping if this partner callback should map to org_8421, 3) patch ingestion to log more verbosely and raise an alert when callback 200s result in no ledger writes.

mike_billing: I'll perform manual adjustment now. Creating ledger entry with amount 1000 (trial tokens) and reference claim_5a9f. Doing it under billing ticket BILL-1124 and will add an audit comment: "manual credit: partner callback mapped to acct_994; customer org_8421; reconciled 1717777".

jo_eng: Can you hold on that until I double-check whether there's a duplicate id issue? If claim id already processed for acct_994 we don't want to credit twice. Running quick query...

promo-bot: ledger_ingest: query for external_claim=claim_5a9f -> NO existing ledger write found

jo_eng: Good — no duplicate. Root cause: partner submission used the partner's merchant id that maps to our internal test billing account instead of the customer's org id. It looks like partner-side routing logic selected the wrong tenant header. We'll flag with partnerships.

mike_billing: Manual credit posted: ledger_txn_67821 -> +1000 units to org_8421. Audit note: "manual credit for claim_5a9f after merchant->org mismatch; partner callback 200 but ingestion skipped". Customer notified.

leah_cs: Thanks — I told the customer we applied credits and they confirmed balance updated. Closing ticket once they confirm usage works.

sasha: Action items: - jo_eng to add a short alert when a callback returns 200 but ingestion results in zero ledger writes for that claim id (low volume but high impact). - partnerships to confirm partner routing to emit correct tenant header. - billing to add a compact reconciliation report for merchant->acct->org mapping mismatches.

jo_eng: I filed ENG-4312 to add the alert and improve the log message. Example alert rule: if webhook_response==200 AND ledger_writes==0 -> create pagerduty ticket for support-escalations.

mike_billing: Filing BILL-1124 with manual credit details and reconciliation steps.

leah_cs: I'll follow up with the customer in 24h to confirm no further issues. Marking as escalated->resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
